purpose: Adjudications for offline similarity findings. Each determination is re-verified from the file's current content by scripts/ip/build-offline-similarity-evidence.mjs on every run; an adjudication is evidence of a re-checkable property, never a standing exemption. Editing an adjudicated file so that it carries real logic makes the determination stop holding and returns the finding to the unresolved count.

determinations.RE_EXPORT_BARREL_NO_EXPRESSION: The file's normalized token set lies entirely within the re-export idiom {export, *, from, <STRING>, ;}. Normalization replaces every string literal with <STRING>, so the module paths - the only content that distinguishes one barrel from another - are erased before comparison. What matches is the idiom skeleton, which carries no protectable expression in either direction. Verified by recomputing the token set at run time.

adjudications.rationale: Six-line re-export barrel for the execution-simulation module. Measured token set is exactly {*, ;, <STRING>, export, from} (30 tokens, 5 distinct). It matched index.d.ts barrels in @nestjs/common, @nestjs/core, fork-ts-checker-webpack-plugin and zod purely on that skeleton; the exported module names share nothing with any of them. No implementation text is common.
